slice: Invoices New-Invoice composer (spec 16 item 6 + spec 17): light up the dark "New invoice" CTA on all three platforms with a composer dialog wired to a new server-side createInvoice onCall wrapper (audit + notify), and add a generateReceipt onCall + receipt notification key to back the per-row/header "Receipt" action.
summary: A "New invoice" composer dialog (kinfolk picker + invoice fields) opens from the Invoices header on web Wasm, desktop JVM, and Android. On save it calls a new MyTribe createInvoice onCall wrapper that writes to the flat invoices collection with a generated id, stamps kinfolkId, and reuses postInvoiceEvent's audit (BILLING_INVOICE_CREATED) + invoice.new notification. A companion generateReceipt onCall marks an invoice receipted and enqueues a new invoice.receipt notification, lighting the receipt action that ships dark today. All flags flip on once the callables land.
alreadyExists: Backend: postInvoiceEvent onCall already creates/updates an invoice in the flat `invoices` collection with audit BILLING_INVOICE_CREATED + invoice.new/invoice.updated notify (MyTribe/functions/src/admin/postInvoiceEvent.ts:19-60; exported index.ts:68). Its zod Args takes {familyId, invoiceId, payload} and merge-sets, so it can be the write path but it requires the CLIENT to mint invoiceId and does NOT generate an invoice number. Audit event BILLING_INVOICE_CREATED already defined (lib/auditEvents.ts:54). Notification keys invoice.new + invoice.updated exist (notifications/catalog.ts:214-238) with email/push templates. NO invoice.receipt key/template exists. NO createInvoice or generateReceipt callable exists anywhere (grep of functions/src empty). Frontend already-built (do NOT rebuild): full Invoices list/filter/summary/row UI on web (web/.../screens/invoices/InvoicesScreen.kt) and android (android/.../ui/admin/InvoicesScreen.kt), both with the NewInvoiceCta gated dark. Web gate = central FeatureFlags.invoicesCreate=false (config/FeatureFlags.kt:66) consumed via LocalFeatureFlags at InvoicesScreen.kt:236; receipt gate = flags.invoicesGenerateReceipt (FeatureFlags.kt:70, used InvoicesScreen.kt:527). Android gates = local consts FF_INVOICE_CREATE / FF_INVOICE_RECEIPT (InvoicesScreen.kt:82-84). Invoice model exists tri-platform: web data class Invoice (FirestoreClient.kt:973-993), android Invoice (data/model/Models.kt:209-229) - identical field set. Callable plumbing exists: platformInvokeCallable expect (FirestoreClient.kt:633), wasm actual (FirestoreInterop.wasmJs.kt:1055), jvm actual = JvmFirestoreRest.callable (FirestoreInterop.jvm.kt:302-304); createKinCareSession (FirestoreClient.kt:314-339) is the exact buildJsonObject+platformInvokeCallable+decode pattern to copy. Android repository.createInvoice EXISTS but writes invoices collection DIRECTLY via Firestore SDK with NO audit/notify (AuntieRepository.kt:806-811) and VM wrapper exists (AdminDataViewModel.kt:239-249) - this is the one path that must be REROUTED to the callable, not reused as-is. RecordPaymentDialog (web PaymentsScreen.kt:415-550) is the dialog/validation pattern to mirror; kinfolkStream() exists for the picker (FirestoreClient.kt:30).

backend.plan: Create MyTribe/functions/src/admin/createInvoice.ts: onCall + wrapAdminCallable('createInvoice', handler). zod Args = { familyId: z.string().min(1), kinfolkName: z.string().default(''), invoiceNumber: z.string().min(1), client: z.string().default(''), address: z.string().default(''), date: z.string().default(''), terms: z.string().default(''), dueDate: z.string().default(''), discount: z.string().default(''), total: z.number().nonnegative(), amountDue: z.number().nonnegative(), status: z.string().default(''), sessionIds: z.array(z.string()).default([]) }. Handler: const ref = db().collection('invoices').doc(); await ref.set({ ...fields, kinfolkId: args.familyId, _id: ref.id, createdAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(), updatedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp() }); writeAuditEntry({ event: AUDIT_EVENTS.BILLING_INVOICE_CREATED, severity:'info', actorRole:'AUNTIE', actorUid: req.auth!.uid, familyId: args.familyId, payload:{ invoiceId: ref.id, invoiceNumber: args.invoiceNumber } }); resolveKinfolkUid(args.familyId) then enqueueNotification({ key:'invoice.new', recipientUid: uid??'', data:{ kinfolkId: args.familyId, invoiceId: ref.id } }) wrapped in try/catch logEvent('notification.dispatch.failed') exactly like postInvoiceEvent.ts:37-52. Return { ok:true, invoiceId: ref.id }. Export from index.ts next to postInvoiceEvent (line 68). Reuse imports/region/cors/secrets block verbatim from postInvoiceEvent.ts:1-11,57-60. ALSO create MyTribe/functions/src/admin/generateReceipt.ts: onCall + wrapAdminCallable('generateReceipt'). zod Args = { invoiceId: z.string().min(1) }. Handler: ref = db().collection('invoices').doc(args.invoiceId); snap = await ref.get(); if(!snap.exists) throw new HttpsError('not-found','invoice not found') (fail loud); read kinfolkId from snap; await ref.set({ receiptIssuedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(), receiptIssuedBy: req.auth!.uid }, {merge:true}); writeAuditEntry({ event: AUDIT_EVENTS.BILLING_INVOICE_PAID-or-new BILLING_RECEIPT_ISSUED, ... }); add a new audit const BILLING_RECEIPT_ISSUED:'BILLING_RECEIPT_ISSUED' to lib/auditEvents.ts:54-56 block; add notification key 'invoice.receipt' to notifications/catalog.ts mirroring invoice.new entry (214-238) with templates {email:'invoice.receipt', push:'invoice.receipt'} (user authors template copy - seed placeholder Firestore template docs, do NOT author customer-facing words); enqueueNotification({ key:'invoice.receipt', recipientUid, data:{ invoiceId } }) same try/catch. Return { ok:true }. Reasoning for NOT just calling postInvoiceEvent: it requires the client to mint invoiceId and never generates a server id; a thin createInvoice wrapper that server-mints the doc id is cleaner and keeps the invoiceId authoritative. Decision needed from operator only on whether invoiceNumber is client-entered (composer field) or server-sequenced - default plan = client-entered free-text field validated non-blank, matching the existing model where invoiceNumber is a plain string.

frontend.changes: 1) FirestoreClient.kt: add suspend fun createInvoice(invoice: Invoice): WriteResult<String> after recordPayment (around line 299) using the createKinCareSession pattern (FirestoreClient.kt:314-339): buildJsonObject putting familyId=invoice.kinfolkId + kinfolkName/invoiceNumber/client/address/date/terms/dueDate/discount/status + total/amountDue as JsonPrimitive(Double) + sessionIds JsonArray; platformInvokeCallable('createInvoice', callableJson.encodeToString(...)); decode jsonObject['invoiceId']. Add suspend fun generateReceipt(invoiceId: String): WriteResult<Unit> calling platformInvokeCallable('generateReceipt', {invoiceId}). These need NO new expect/actual because platformInvokeCallable already exists on both targets. 2) New NewInvoiceDialog.kt mirroring RecordPaymentDialog (PaymentsScreen.kt:415-550): AuntieDialog title 'New invoice', fields invoiceNumber (required), kinfolk picker via remember{client.kinfolkStream()} collectAsState -> AuntieSelectField binding kinfolkId+kinfolkName (reuse household-facet select pattern InvoicesScreen.kt:344), client, address, date+dueDate (isValidIsoDate validation copied from RecordPaymentDialog:431), terms, discount, total + amountDue (KeyboardType.Decimal), status select (draft/sent). Validation: invoiceNumber non-blank, total>=0, amountDue>=0, dates valid-or-blank; fail-loud validationError banner exactly like PaymentsScreen.kt:468-479. onConfirm builds Invoice and calls client.createInvoice in a rememberCoroutineScope, surfacing WriteResult.Err in the banner (never swallow). 3) InvoicesScreen.kt NewInvoiceCta (232-257): when flags.invoicesCreate true, PrimaryButton onClick opens dialog state var; replace empty onClick at :240. Flip FeatureFlags.invoicesCreate default to true (config/FeatureFlags.kt:66) ONLY after callable deployed, else keep dark - report both. RowAction receipt branch (527-532): replace empty GhostButton onClick with client.generateReceipt(invoice._id) in scope; flip invoicesGenerateReceipt (FeatureFlags.kt:70). Update EmptyState banner copy (549-563) to drop the now-false 'creation isnt wired' line.

NO new actual needed: createInvoice/generateReceipt route through the existing platformInvokeCallable actual (FirestoreInterop.wasmJs.kt:1055) which posts to the Firebase callable endpoint. Verify the wasm callable bridge serializes the JSON payload unchanged (it already does for createKinCareSession). No code change unless a build surfaces a missing-actual error, which it will not since the common-layer functions only call platformInvokeCallable.

NO new actual needed: platformInvokeCallable jvm actual (FirestoreInterop.jvm.kt:302-304) already routes to JvmFirestoreRest.callable(name, payloadJson) over REST with the runtime ID token, so createInvoice/generateReceipt work on desktop the moment the MyTribe callables deploy. JvmFirestoreFixtures.callableResponses is consulted first (line 303) so integration tests can stub both callables. No production code change.

1) AuntieRepository.createInvoice (AuntieRepository.kt:806-811) currently writes the invoices collection DIRECTLY via firestore.collection('invoices').document().set(...) with NO audit and NO notify - REROUTE it to the new callable: functions.getHttpsCallable('createInvoice').call(mapOf('familyId' to invoice.kinfolkId, 'invoiceNumber' to invoice.invoiceNumber, 'kinfolkName' to invoice.kinfolkName, 'client' to invoice.client, 'address' to invoice.address, 'date' to invoice.date, 'terms' to invoice.terms, 'dueDate' to invoice.dueDate, 'discount' to invoice.discount, 'total' to invoice.total, 'amountDue' to invoice.amountDue, 'status' to invoice.status, 'sessionIds' to invoice.sessionIds)).await(); read result['invoiceId']. Use the same FirebaseFunctions instance other Android callables use (check how an existing getHttpsCallable site like manageBookingSeries/recordPayment is wired in this repo; if Android uses NativeAndroidFunctionsClient per memory project_native_android_functions_pattern, route through that). Add suspend fun generateReceipt(invoiceId: String): Result<Unit> calling getHttpsCallable('generateReceipt'). 2) AdminDataViewModel: keep createInvoice(invoice) (239-249); add fun generateReceipt(invoiceId). 3) InvoicesScreen.kt: NewInvoiceCta (300-324) onClick opens new NewInvoiceDialog; flip FF_INVOICE_CREATE=true (line 82) and FF_INVOICE_RECEIPT=true (84) once deployed; RowAction receipt GhostButton (574-578) calls viewModel.generateReceipt. 4) New NewInvoiceDialog.kt: AuntieDialog (use the existing android RecordPaymentDialog equivalent if present, else AuntieDropdownField for kinfolk picker fed by viewModel.loadKinfolkDirectory/kinfolks state) with same fields+validation as web; on confirm viewModel.createInvoice(Invoice(...)). Update EmptyState copy (592-609) to drop the false 'creation isnt wired' sentence.

errorHandling: Backend fails loud: zod .parse throws on bad args (surfaces as HttpsError invalid-argument); generateReceipt throws HttpsError('not-found') when the invoice doc is missing; notification dispatch is the ONLY swallowed path and is logged via logEvent severity:warn event:'notification.dispatch.failed' exactly as postInvoiceEvent.ts:45-52 (write succeeds even if notify fails, by design, and is disclosed in the log). Web: createInvoice/generateReceipt return WriteResult.Err(message) which the dialog renders in the red validationError banner (mirroring PaymentsScreen.kt:468-479) and the row action surfaces via a StatusToast/banner; the WriteResult.Err is never discarded. Desktop: JvmFirestoreRest.callable returns WriteResult.Err on non-2xx which flows to the same banner. Android: getHttpsCallable(...).await() failure is caught by repository runCatching -> Result.failure -> VM sets _error.value (AdminDataViewModel.kt:244-246) which the screen already renders as a dismiss-less AuntieBanner Error (InvoicesScreen.kt:223-235). No silent degradation anywhere; no fabricated invoice ids (server mints them). Validation (invoiceNumber non-blank, total/amountDue>=0, ISO dates) runs client-side first AND server-side via zod (defense in depth).

tests.e2e: Playwright web harness (docs/2026-05-31-visual-testing-design.md hermetic pattern): with the functions emulator stubbing createInvoice + generateReceipt and seeded invoices, open Invoices, click 'New invoice', fill the composer, save, assert a new row appears and a success toast shows; click Receipt on a paid row, assert the receipt action resolves. Re-baseline the Invoices + composer-open golden via baseline.mjs (this screen becomes a prod-callable screen, so seed deterministic fixture data, never live prod). Desktop e2e via Roborazzi screenshot of the open dialog. Honest note: full cross-platform device e2e is deferred per project_testing_deferred; unit+integration+UI gate the build.

risks: 1) postInvoiceEvent vs new createInvoice overlap: I am adding a thin createInvoice wrapper rather than reusing postInvoiceEvent because the latter forces the client to mint invoiceId and cannot server-generate a doc id or an invoice number; confirm operator is fine with a second small callable (low risk, identical audit/notify code). 2) invoiceNumber generation is left as a client-entered free-text field (matching the existing string model) - if the operator wants server-sequenced numbers that is a follow-up needing a counter doc + transaction. 3) Android repository.createInvoice today writes Firestore directly with no audit/notify - rerouting it to the callable is a behavior change (now audited + notifies the kinfolk); any caller depending on the old silent direct-write must be checked (grep shows only the invoice composer path uses it). 4) New invoice.receipt notification template copy must be authored by the user (memory: never author customer-facing copy) - seed placeholder template docs only and flag for the operator. 5) Flags (FeatureFlags.invoicesCreate/invoicesGenerateReceipt web + FF_INVOICE_CREATE/RECEIPT android) must only flip true AFTER the callables deploy, or the buttons fail loud at runtime; default the PR to flags-on-with-callables-deployed and call this out. 6) Wasm callable serialization of Double total/amountDue - verify the wasm bridge preserves numeric types (createKinCareSession only sends strings/ints), add a guard test.
